# BridgePit - bridgepit.com

BridgePit is desktop software for macOS (Apple Silicon) that executes
TradingView strategy alerts on the trader's own futures broker account,
locally from the trader's own computer and IP address - no cloud middleman.
Built for traders who want their orders placed from their own machine,
not a VPS. Semi-automated by design: it executes, the trader
supervises. Kill-switch, position caps, duplicate rejection and EOD
auto-flatten are on from the start; the daily loss stop is the one
number the trader enters.
Credentials are encrypted on the trader's machine and never touch our servers.
PickMyTrade cutover is not one URL edit: /v2/add-trade-data still answers, but
the message needs the app's strategy name and your BridgePit token. Copy block
writes both, plus the two clocks. Keep the old body and the alert is refused.
Broker support: Rithmic - the connection rail most major prop firms offer;
BridgePit passed Rithmic vendor conformance on 2026-07-13. Supported firms are
announced at launch, and each firm sets its own API-access fee, paid by the
trader directly to the firm. Pricing: paper trading is free now. Seat $59/mo (1 account), Desk $99 (up to 3), Floor $149 (up to 10), coming soon.
Yearly = 2 months free. More than 10 accounts: contact us.
